title: Nul model
text:
\[
h = \gamma_s \times \gamma_p \times \frac{\alpha_0 \times dbh}{\beta_0+dbh}
\]


Code
data <- readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1")
model <- cmdstan_model("models/nul.stan")
path <- "chains/nul"
if(file.exists(path))
  unlink(path, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(path)
fit <- model$sample(
    data = list(
      N = nrow(data),
      P = max(data$num_plot),
      S = max(data$num_species),
      plot = data$num_plot,
      species = data$num_species,
      h = data$H,
      dbh = data$dbh
    ),
    chains = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    threads_per_chain = 4,
    save_warmup = FALSE,
    output_dir = path,
    refresh = 100
  )

title: Comparisons
text:
Code
data <- readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1")
fit_nul <- as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/nul", full.names = TRUE))
fit_s <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/system", full.names = TRUE))
fit_o <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/origin", full.names = TRUE))
fit_so <-  as_cmdstan_fit(list.files("chains/systemorigin", full.names = TRUE))
data$pred_nul <- fit_nul$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_s <- fit_s$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_o <- fit_o$summary("h_p", "median")$median
data$pred_so <- fit_so$summary("h_p", "median")$median
write_tsv(data, "outputs/data_pred_all.tsv")




Code
read_tsv("outputs/data_pred_all.tsv") %>% 
  select(system, H, pred_nul, 
         pred_s, pred_o, 
         pred_so) %>% 
  gather(model, prediction, -system, -H) %>% 
  mutate(model = recode(model, 
                        "pred_nul" = "nul",
                        "pred_o" = "origin",
                        "pred_s" = "system",
                        "pred_so" = "system-origin")) %>% 
  mutate(error = prediction - H) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(error, fill = model)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5, col = NA) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ system, scales = "free") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
